name: math_benchmark_train
description: A collection of math problems intended for training and evaluating language models on symbolic and numeric problem solving across a range of elementary to intermediate topics. The dataset measures models' ability to produce correct numeric answers and intermediate reasoning steps when required. It is primarily used as a training resource for improving mathematical reasoning capabilities in LLMs.
reputation: A relatively small / task-specific training resource with limited broad community adoption compared to major public math benchmarks.
